title: Tensioning.
officialText:
Initial tension may be applied mechanically to the fabric display area, but it shall be held in final
position by adjusting or tightening the turnbuckles, or the nuts holding the “J” hooks to the restraining angles. Mechanical
tensioning devices may not remain attached to the flexible sign, except as permitted by Section H114.4.
